summary: This directory contains the testing suite for the package analysis logic, focused on verifying the correctness of package analysis reports and the ranking of directory structures based on computed scores.
responsibilities: Verify the accuracy of package analysis calculations
Validate the logic used to rank directories based on specific scoring criteria
Ensure consistent behavior of analysis utilities under test conditions
relationships: The test suite verifies that package analysis results are processed correctly by the ranking algorithms.
Directory ranking logic depends on the output generated by package analysis to determine the relative importance of file structures.
designDecisions: Isolated testing of core analytical functions
Usage of automated test cases to validate business logic heuristics
Separation of testing logic from production implementation
